thread:
maya: Heads-up — VeloxPay (dedicated pool velox-prod) seeing intermittent 503s and request timeouts since ~03:15 UTC. CS says this is hitting their p95 SLA. Can eng-platform + eng-sre pick an owner and a quick mitigation plan? cc @jordan @liam

jordan: I can take lead on the platform side. First pass: enable fallback routing to model-compact-v1 and scale pool replicas by +2 for velox-prod. Need a quick config PR and can trigger rollout.

liam: On it for SRE. I'm looking at kube events and node metrics now. Early sign: one GPU node is flapping with OOM kills and there's an elevated KV cache miss rate which is increasing latencies. Reproduced error in logs:```ERROR pipeline: out-of-memory, pod=vx-serving-3, OOMKilled```

maya: thx. Alex-CS will notify customer of investigation. We need an ETA for mitigation and whether there's a safe immediate workaround we can offer (e.g., pinned concurrency or temp fallback).

ana: ping @ana — can you review the fallback routing PR? It's small (2 files) and needs a quick approve to unblock the rollout. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4824

ana: sorry typo — @ana ^^

ana: I ran the PR locally, looks fine but need one more sec to run integration smoke. ETA 20m.

ops-bot: Deployment job started for platform/fallback-routing (run-id: dpl_8942). Status: queued.

jordan: Work items and ownership: platform PR + rollout — jordan. SRE incident triage + node remediation — liam. CS comms — alex-cs. QA smoke + final sign-off on routing tests — ana. I'll also prepare a quick rollback plan (route back to primary model or pause rollout)

liam: Node remediation plan: cordon vx-node-12, drain, restart kubelet, check GPU driver logs. If OOM persists across node we may need to isolate the workload and schedule on new nodes. ETA for cordon/drain + restart: 30–45m.

maya: Good. Jordan — can you also add a temporary autoscale override for velox-prod to keep extra capacity until we stabilize? Make it explicit in the PR description.

jordan: Will do. Adding autoscale override and notes on rollback. Target rollout window: in 40m, aiming for <2% request routing change initially (canary).

alex-cs: I'll message VeloxPay that we're actively mitigating, giving an ETA ~60m and offering the compact model as an interim option. They asked for a status callback at +1h.

ana: smoke tests passed locally. Leaving one test run in staging. If green, I can merge and trigger the rollout.

ops-bot: CI: staging smoke tests passed (job: smoke-staging-77).

jordan: Merged and initiated canary rollout (canary 5%). Monitoring latencies/5xx now.

liam: Noted a reduction in 5xx on canary traffic. I'm still draining vx-node-12. If canary stays stable for 10m, we'll ramp to 30% and keep monitoring.

maya: Great. Please post final status once ramp complete. Also add a short incident note in #incidents with root cause hypothesis (OOM + cache misses) and follow-ups (capacity bump, cache tuning, rollout safety checks).

alex-cs: Customer updated. They appreciate quick action. Will escalate for credits if regression persists.

jordan: Canary at 30%, p95 latency trending down, 5xx count near zero. Rolling to 100% in 15m unless SRE flags.

liam: vx-node-12 restarted, no further OOMs observed. Will keep it cordoned until we confirm driver stability.

maya: Thanks team. Owners: jordan (platform), liam (sre), ana (qa). Follow-ups: postmortem + capacity plan. Closing thread after final confirmation. :thumbsup:
